main_text.head: INDEX CORONARUM
main_text.p: Scopuli: Ira Principis, Suspicio Principis; Parium invidia, Sycophantia; Objur-gatio Principis.
main_text.head: IV. CORONÆ CIVICÆ FLORES.
main_text.p: i. Desubdito-um officio:DEUM time: Regem honora. Honoratur au-tem Rex
main_text.l: Precibus piis pro ipsius salute fusis.
main_text.p: 2. obedientia:Omnis anima potestatibus sublimioribus esto subdita: idque propter
Subditis, ad impia sacra coactis, quid faciendum?
3. tributo:Reddite, quæ sunt Cæsaris, Cæsari: & quæ Dei, Deo. Hic simul docetur:
Tributa certo monetæ genere à Romanis olim fuisse imperata.
Tributum quando Judæis primùm à Romanis impositum.

page.notes: Greek word after "Occursu:" is uncertain (read as Προπομπή); marked [?]. Scan is faint at the edges. Long s read as plain s; "Desubdito-" shows an f-like long s. Hyphens at line ends kept as printed.
